text:
Nina: Quick mood check — who's up for a micro one-liner sprint? Drop your best 5-word life hacks.
Omar: I'm in. Rules: keep it under 6 words, deliver with emoji.
dev-bot: Reminder: #general etiquette still applies. Be kind. :robot_face:
Luca: "Always add cinnamon to coffee." :coffee:
Tess: "Reply-all is a public service." :joy:
Riya: "Turn notifications off, live more." :mute:
Connor: "Plants > Post-it notes for memory." :seedling:
Nina: Nice ones. Bonus for puns.
Omar: "Keyboard crumbs accept no excuses." :bread:
Luca: "Charge phone mid-meeting, skip awkwardness." :phone:
Tess: "Bring snacks, become instantly popular." :cookie:
Riya: Shoutout to Tess for the almond croissants earlier 64f
Connor: Agreed. Bakery runs = morale engineering.
Nina: Poll: should we do a monthly micro-quip channel thread? React :heavy_check_mark: for yes, :x: for no, :thinking_face: if you want to judge entries.
Omar: Also can we archive the winners in a tiny repo? "quip-archive"? :link:
dev-bot: Created issue #42 in clubhouse/office-fun: "quip-archive initial setup"
Luca: I'll volunteer to add stickers.
Tess: If we do stickers, can we have one that says "I survived the last all-hands"?
Riya: I want a plant-themed one. "Fern Friend" badge.
Connor: Final one-liner from me: "Mute mic, still speak to universe." :microphone:
Nina: Thanks team. Thread closed in 20 min for voting. May the best micro-quip win. :tada:
